title: POST JSON with fetch
why_it_matters: Every form, login and booking in your apps does this.
explanation: For a POST you pass an options object: the method, a Content-Type header saying the body is JSON, and the body as a JSON string. Forgetting JSON.stringify sends the useless text '[object Object]'.
try_it: Write the same call for another endpoint, like /api/bookings, with two fields.
